heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this chapter $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2023 through 2027.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 14043h–7 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
Amendments2022—Pub. L. 117–103 substituted “2023 through 2027” for “2015 through 2019”.
